import pandas as pd
dfs = [pd.read_parquet(f'/tmp/train-{i:05d}-of-00004.parquet') for i in range(4)]

    return any(any(c in str(x).lower() for c in codes) for x in l)

    if all(any(c in x for c in codes) for x in langs):
        tasks.add(t)
sub = sc[sc['task_name'].isin(tasks)]

mt = sub.groupby(['model_name','task_name'])['score'].max().reset_index()
mean = mt.groupby('model_name')['score'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
top = mean.head(30)
print(top)
# save
top.to_csv('/tmp/scandi_top.csv')
